channel.title: Appsflyer incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Appsflyer's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Dashboards availability [resolved]
item.description: Some of our services were impacted by a DNS issue between 14:35 and 15:35 UTC. During this time: clicks and impressions processing was delayed, which resulted in a temporary increase in organic attribution; the Onelink API was partially available; and some processed events are missing geo data. The issue has been fully resolved. Please contact our support team with any questions.

item.title: appsflyer.com domain availability [resolved]
item.description: We are seeing significantly fewer reports related to domain mapping and expect the DNS propagation process to complete in the coming hours. We are marking this incident as resolved. If you have any questions or need assistance, our team is available to help.

item.title: Dashboard Availability [resolved]
item.description: Dashboard availability has been fully restored. Our teams continue to monitor performance. If you encounter any further issues, please contact Technical Support.

item.title: AppsFlyer - TikTok Attribution Impact Due to TikTok Attribution API Errors [resolved]
AppsFlyer - Meta attribution impact due to errors from Meta ads’ attribution API [resolved]
item.description: Meta API availability has returned to normal, and we continue to monitor conversion rates closely. We will update this page if any further anomalies occur. Thank you for your patience.

item.title: An issue with processing clicks and impressions [resolved]
item.description: Our teams reprocessed engagements from approximately 10:25 AM UTC to 11:15 AM UTC, and those engagements are now available for new conversions. Thank you for your patience, and please contact us for any related questions.

item.title: Meta attribution impact due to errors from Meta ads’ attribution API [resolved]
item.description: Meta API availability has returned to normal, and we continue to monitor conversion rates closely. We will update this page if any further anomalies occur. Thank you for your patience.

item.title: Delay in Push API messages [resolved]
item.description: The Push API delay issue is resolved. The backlog of events not sent since 01:07 UTC is now being delivered and will clear over the next few hours. We’re monitoring until completion.

item.title: Unavailable Integrated Partners Settings page for some of the partners [resolved]
item.description: We can confirm that the issue is now resolved.
